name: help-connect-public-pwa

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-operator.mjs && node scripts/validate-dist.mjs && node scripts/validate-operator-dist.mjs && node scripts/validate-privacy.mjs && node scripts/validate-cache-policy.mjs && node scripts/check-budget.mjs
scripts.check:operator-api: node --check operator-api/src/config-validation.mjs && node --check operator-api/src/security-core.mjs && node --check operator-api/src/store.mjs && node --check operator-api/src/webauthn-adapter.mjs && node --check operator-api/src/server.mjs
